storyCards.headline: Small Town Throwdown: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Brantley Gilbert's "Small Town Throwdown" reached #67 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Small Town Throwdown" is a song co-written and recorded by American country rock singer Brantley Gilbert as a collaboration with Justin Moore and Thomas Rhett.

The song peaked at #67 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Small Town Throwdown was released in 2014.

"Small Town Throwdown" by Brantley Gilbert.
